notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No formula was changed from mathematical expectation. The written NB automatically les wording and the right-note Sigma reading remain as observed. No proof, theorem, example or mathematical computation was performed.
notes.source_doubt_mapping: The 21 actual rows in C Doubtful readings map to D01a/D01b, D02 through D08, D09a/D09b, D10 through D20, and D21a/D21b. The seven notation rows, three Slips retained rows and seven abbreviation rows were treated as their supplied source categories, not additional source doubts.
notes.source_apparatus: H drawing orientation and explanatory description are treated as apparatus. H uncertainty markers alone do not create a difference. One H ill remainder is counted once in H04; local D16 is covered by it. Shared physical clusters are cross-referenced where a graphical detail has no additional H count.
notes.drawing_path_map: The main drawing uses the individually checked C contour, two transverse paths, two left-brace paths and one right brace. Its mapping is full scan = local + (22,1069). G08 splits the weak lower-right rim into supported runs. Upper cancelled label crossings use CANCEL01. Other fixed origins are stated next to their commands and in the graphical rows.

Crop 14 cuts part of the descender from the neighbouring word but retains its actual targets. Crop 17 leaves the lower-note far-right ending at the edge; the uncertainty is retained. No new crop was made for these limits.
